2538.title: Bug - Refusing to start a competing turn for thread "<threadid>" while another turn is active or starting (Codex)
2538.rootCauseOneLine: A recreated Codex translator ignores an unknown child interaction, so it emits the resumed child turn without its parent tool call.

prReviews.topFinding: The core fix passes, but unrelated gzip snapshot changes make the host daemon contract suite fail on supported Node 24.

2538.proposedFix: Restore follow-up intent and child identity after translator recreation. Require a matched child turn, discard message-only events, and increment the protocol version.
2538.caveats: The first install and one contract rerun hit shared /tmp inode limits. Shared dependencies and an isolated temporary directory let all required checks complete. No live provider turn was used.

2532.title: Enabled plugin agent tools can be absent from freshly dispatched project lanes
2532.rootCauseOneLine: Thread creation has no required-tool preflight, so the queued start can resolve before a plugin recognizes lane ownership.
2532.proposedFix: Add requiredAgentToolIds to thread creation and SDK spawn. Resolve tools before insertion and hold the plugin generation through enqueue. Return server-resolved IDs and a digest as a server receipt. Add and await a daemon receipt before BB claims that the daemon mounted the tools.
2532.caveats: The issue omits the original lane, host, provider transcript, and downstream database. The route test uses a controlled 250 ms delay. It proves the contract gap and one matching sequence. It does not prove the reporter's exact sequence.

2509.title: ACP provider process dies after bb-bridge initialize hangup
2509.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP bridge omits an error listener on accepted TCP sockets, so a normal initialize reset exits the provider process.

prReviews.topFinding: The fix handles the accepted-socket error and passes all 289 tests. Two no-op listeners are a low-risk cleanup concern.

2509.proposedFix: Attach one error listener when the TCP server accepts a socket. Keep reset errors local, destroy that socket, and retain the shared server.
2509.caveats: A live macOS multi-account path was unavailable. The normal Linux path did not reset. A forced Linux reset reproduced the fault. The first install hit inode exhaustion, so tests used the matching shared dependency tree.

2503.title: 0.40.0 Cursor picker: only Grok keeps a real reasoning ladder (Sol/Opus/Fable dummy Medium)
2503.rootCauseOneLine: The five-second Grok-first ACP probe times out before Sol and Claude primary models, and bb selects Thinking instead of Effort.
2503.proposedFix: Probe Cursor primary models before selected-only models with an adequate budget. Select the thought_level option with mapped reasoning values. Add delayed 35-model and dual-option tests.
2503.caveats: Cursor ACP supplies no reasoning list for Composer 2.5. The report did not run bb 0.39.0 or start a paid Cursor turn. The raw GitHub fallback works after publication; the local artifact path works before publication.

2480.title: [desktop] "Could not start bb" most of the time
2480.rootCauseOneLine: The desktop probe marks a temporary config request abort as incompatible and stops before its wait loop can retry.
2480.proposedFix: Classify system-config network failures as unavailable, and retry them before the startup deadline. Keep HTTP and schema failures incompatible. Use a request timeout separate from the 250 ms poll interval.
2480.caveats: The investigation did not run the reporter's Linux Mint AppImage or capture a screenshot. It reproduced the exact probe result with a deterministic loopback test. The initial install failed because /tmp had no free inodes, so the desktop build used the initial checkout dependency tree.

2460.title: thread.start fails with "Internal error" (502 command_failed) when using Ox Alpha via omp harness
2460.rootCauseOneLine: bb 0.39.0 started the MCP child with the provider bootstrap, so OMP rejected the ACP session.
2460.proposedFix: No new code change is necessary. Commit aab0cd710d fixed the MCP entry and kept ACP error details. Close #2460 as a duplicate of #1918. Advise an update to bb 0.40.0 or later.
2460.caveats: The old-release install needed an external package store because /tmp had no free file records. The run used no OpenRouter account. The fault occurred before model work. All seven base tests passed.
